items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And the father played drums and Moms played piano. I think that's how it was. If I'm wrong, I stand to be corrected.

ctx.x: And when King Cole had an engagement to play, he went in advance to rehearse the band. He was a musician. All just brought it out of him. Now the family, they had a family band and Lester was playing piano, I think he started on the piano. But in the band, he played trumpet and drums. And Lee danced and Irma played saxophone. I think Lee played trumpet
and the father played drums and Moms played piano. I think that's how it was. If I'm wrong, I stand to be corrected. But they all, you know, it was a family band.
That was here in Los Angeles?
